<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:heavy-helicopter-rotor -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/heavy-helicopter-rotor).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> large_rotor: definition attribute force_emitter_max_force. Force-emitter configuration; not measured thrust.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/17/findings/0/detail`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> huge_rotor: definition attribute force_emitter_max_force. Force-emitter configuration; not measured thrust.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/17/findings/1/detail`

**Practical behavior guidance**

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/17/findings/2/detail`

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/17/findings/3/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Torque, speed, fuel use and efficiency curves are unknown. Internal configuration fields are not measured force, torque, watts or joules.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/206/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> heavy_rotor: attributes.force_emitter_max_force. Selected propeller/rotor configuration. This is not measured thrust in newtons.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/206/findings/9/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> heavy_rotor_large: attributes.force_emitter_max_force. Selected propeller/rotor configuration. This is not measured thrust in newtons.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/206/findings/23/detail`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
